title: Parcel rating function and its unit tests
name: Parcel rate quoting

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the quoteShipment tests set up and isolate their fixtures? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A parcel weighs 500 g and measures 50 x 40 x 30 cm. What billable weight does billableWeightKg return?
choices: 1 kg, because actual weight rounds up
12 kg, the volumetric weight rounded up
60 kg, the raw volume divided by 1000

questions.prompt: What side effect does quoteShipment have on its input when a parcel is longer than 120 cm?
choices: It removes the oversize parcel from `parcels`
It appends "oversize" to the caller's `surcharges` array if not already present
None; it only returns a new lines array

questions.prompt: In the 'prices express higher than ground' test, why can the spread `{ ...shipment, serviceLevel: "express" }` still affect other tests?
choices: It cannot; spreading deep-copies parcels and surcharges
Spreading changes serviceLevel on the original object
Spreading triggers the beforeAll hook again
The spread is shallow, so `surcharges` and `parcels` arrays are shared with the original and any push into them is visible elsewhere
